    Proper common-whisker interlacement of paths #

    Formalize the interlacement relation used in the ray-category proof. One elementary step replaces a related inner path by another inside a common left and right context, with at least one nontrivial context path. Interlacement is the equivalence relation generated by these elementary steps.

    source
    def LargeIndecomposable.ProperWhiskerInterlacementStep {Q : Type v} [Quiver Q] (R : PathContourRelation Q) {a b : Q} (p q : Quiver.Path a b) :
    Prop

    One elementary interlacement step: replace related inner paths inside a common proper path context, and require that the resulting outer paths remain related.
